blocks.text:
Gujarat
Panchayats
Act, 1993.
NOTIFICATION 
Panchayats, Rural Housing and Rural Development Department, 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar. 
Dated the 8th September, 2026
 
No.KP/28 of 2026/ PRHRDD/PRC/e-ﬁle/14/2025/2933/Section–Ch: - WHEREAS certain draft rules
were published as required by sub-section (5) of section 274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act,1993 (Guj.
18 of 1993), at pages 188-1 to 188-2 in the Gujarat Government Gazette, Extraordinary, PART I-A,
Central Section, dated the 31st December, 2025, under the Government Notiﬁcation, Panchayats,
Rural Housing and Rural Development Department No. KP/47 of 2025/PRHRDD/PRC/e-
ﬁle/14/2025/2933/Section–Ch:-, dated the 6th  November, 2025 inviting objections and suggestions
from all the persons likely to be aﬀected thereby within a period of thirty days from the date of
publication of the said notification in the Official Gazette;
AND WHEREAS the objections or suggestions received in respect to the said draft rules have been
considered by the Government;
NOW, THEREFORE, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 200 of the
Gujarat Panchayats Act,1993(Guj. 18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat hereby makes the following
rules further to amend the Gujarat Gram and Nagar Panchayats Taxes and Fees Rules,1964,
namely:- 
1. (1) These rules may be called the Gujarat Gram and Nagar Panchayats Taxes and Fees
(Amendment) Rules, 2026.
     (2) They shall come into force on the date of their publication in the Official Gazette.
   2.   In the Gujarat Gram and Nagar Panchayats Taxes and Fees Rules,1964, in rule 7, in  sub- rule
 (2), after clause (i), the following clause shall be added, namely :-
" (j) only one house belonging to serving defence personnel or spouse of serving defence personnel
and Ex-serviceman or widows of martyrs, which he/she uses for his/her own residential purpose,
within territory of the State of Gujarat”.
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat,
(Anjana Rathod)
Joint Secretary to Government.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
To,
Letter No: PRHRDD/0520/08/2026   Approved Date: 08-09-2026 04:03
File No: PRHRDD/PRC/e-file/14/2025/2933/Section - Ch
Approved By: Joint Secretary,Section - Ch,PRHRDD
1/2
